Description: A programmer run is judged on whether it investigated before editing, reported the fix together with the test that pins it, and handed the ticket on without hedging.

Criteria.Name: Dispatch behaved as declared
Criteria.Statement: The run did not behave the way the fixture declares, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.

Criteria.Name: Investigated before editing
Criteria.Statement: The run edited code without reading any of it first.

Criteria.Name: Reported the fix and its regression test
Criteria.Statement: A fix without a stated regression test and a stated next column is not a finished handoff.

Criteria.Name: No hedged handoff
Criteria.Statement: The closing message hedges instead of stating what was changed.

Criteria.Name: Bounded tool use
Criteria.Statement: A one-file fix should not require an open-ended search.
